svg.title: A rejected ATS login has a bounded recovery path
svg.desc: A local private password feeds selected iCIMS and Workday forms. Explicit login errors lead to registration, one configured-password attempt and email recovery. Only the site can confirm completion.
svg.text: Still rejected → visible Forgot / Reset Password
Repeat limits survive reconnects for 15 minutes.
C / A request is not a receipt
No secrets in tool arguments, logs or repository.
Application success still requires the employer’s receipt.
